svg.text: Pure virtual = 0: derived classes must implement it; the abstract class cannot be instantiated.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A class with only pure virtual functions is an interface, such as StreamInsertable.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not call virtual functions in constructors or destructors: the dynamic type is not ready or already gone.
